entities.summary: Maria Friederike Cornelia "Frida" Strindberg was an Austrian writer and translator, who was closely associated with many important figures in 20th-century literature. Frida Uhl was a journalists & chroniclers from Mondsee (1872-04-04, Mondsee–1943-06-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
